name: math-worksheets
description: Printable math worksheets with exact answer keys, by grade, digits and rules.

interface.longDescription:
Make printable math worksheets with an answer key for a student or a whole class. Ask for 2nd grade subtraction without regrouping, a 7 times table drill, 3-digit by 1-digit long division with remainders, missing numbers within 20, or adding fractions with different denominators, and get a print-ready PDF for Letter or A4 paper.

Answers are computed with whole-number and fraction arithmetic, not estimated, and the rules you set hold for each problem: no regrouping or regrouping required, no negative answers, sums within 20, a number of digits such as 2-digit or 3-digit by 1-digit, a times table, same or different denominators. No problem repeats on a sheet.

What you get:
- Problems in stacked column form, long-division brackets, or on one line, with stacked fractions
- A Name, Date and Score line and a short instruction at the top
- An answer key on separate pages at the end, with fraction answers in simplest form
- A set number that prints the same sheet again, and up to 10 different versions with the same rules in one PDF
- Grade presets from kindergarten to grade 6

You can also paste your own problems (for example 45 - 18, 84 ÷ 4, 3/4 + 1/8 or 7 + ? = 12) and get them laid out with the answers computed.

The preview in the chat shows the first page as it prints, with an answers toggle, a Letter or A4 switch, a button for new problems, and a Download PDF button.

Limitations: whole numbers up to 7 digits and proper fractions with denominators up to 20; no word problems, geometry, money, time or algebra; up to 100 problems per sheet and 10 versions per PDF; Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew and emoji characters in titles are left out of the PDF.
defaultPrompt: Make a 2nd grade subtraction worksheet with 20 two-digit problems, no regrouping
Make a 7 times table worksheet with 24 problems and an answer key
Long division worksheet, 3-digit by 1-digit with remainders, 12 problems, A4

positive.prompt: Make a 2nd grade subtraction worksheet with 20 two-digit problems, no regrouping
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_math_worksheet with operation=subtraction, grade=2, digits=2, regrouping=none, count=20. The result is titled 2-Digit Subtraction (No Regrouping): 20 problems with numbers 10 to 99, no borrowing and no negative answers, in column form 5 per row on 1 Letter worksheet page plus 1 answer key page, with a PDF link and a set number.

positive.prompt: Make a 7 times table worksheet with 24 problems and an answer key
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_math_worksheet with operation=multiplication, table=7, count=24. The worksheet 7 Times Table has 24 problems where one number is 7 and the other 0 to 12, chosen from 25 different problems with none repeated, on 1 worksheet page plus 1 answer key page, with a PDF link.

positive.description: Long division with remainders on A4
positive.prompt: Long division worksheet, 3-digit by 1-digit with remainders, 12 problems, A4
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_math_worksheet with operation=division with remainders, digits=3x1, count=12, paper=a4. The result is Long Division: 3-Digit by 1-Digit with Remainders, 12 problems with a divisor 2 to 9 and a number from 100 to 999, every problem with a remainder written like 7 R 2 in the key, long-division brackets 4 per row on A4.

positive.prompt: Make a first grade missing number worksheet, addition and subtraction within 20, 30 problems
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_math_worksheet with operation=missing number, grade=1, within=20, count=30. The worksheet Missing Numbers: Addition and Subtraction within 20 has 30 problems like 9 + ? = 13 with a box for the blank, sums at most 20 and no negative answers, plus an answer key page.

positive.description: Own problems with an answer key
positive.prompt: Turn these into a printable worksheet with an answer key: 12 + 7, 45 - 18, 6 x 7, 84 ÷ 4, 3/4 + 1/8, 7 + ? = 12
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_math_worksheet with problems [12 + 7, 45 - 18, 6 x 7, 84 ÷ 4, 3/4 + 1/8, 7 + ? = 12]. The PDF lays out the 6 problems and the answer key gives 19, 27, 42, 21, 7/8 and 5.

negative.prompt: Sam has 12 apples and gives 5 to Mia. How many apples does Sam have left? Explain it to my 7 year old.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call generate_math_worksheet: the user wants one word problem explained, not a printable worksheet.

negative.prompt: Here is a photo of my son's finished math homework, can you mark which answers are wrong?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call generate_math_worksheet: the plugin makes new worksheets and does not grade a completed one.

negative.prompt: How do I teach long division step by step to a 4th grader?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call generate_math_worksheet: the user asks for a teaching explanation, not a worksheet.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: printable math worksheets for addition, subtraction, times tables, division with and without remainders, mixed practice, missing numbers and basic fractions, with exact answer keys, grade presets K to 6, regrouping and negative-answer rules, set numbers for reprinting, up to 10 versions, Letter or A4.

pl-PL.subtitle: Karty pracy z matematyki
pl-PL.description: Twórz karty pracy z matematyki do druku z kluczem odpowiedzi: dodawanie, odejmowanie, tabliczka mnożenia, dzielenie z resztą i bez, brakujące liczby oraz proste ułamki. Ustal klasę, liczbę cyfr, zakres (np. do 20), brak przekraczania progu dziesiątkowego i brak wyników ujemnych. Każda odpowiedź jest liczona dokładnie, zadania się nie powtarzają, a numer zestawu pozwala wydrukować ten sam arkusz ponownie. PDF w formacie A4 lub Letter.

de-DE.subtitle: Mathe-Blätter mit Lösungen
de-DE.description: Erstelle druckfertige Mathe-Arbeitsblätter mit Lösungsblatt: Addition, Subtraktion, Einmaleins, Division mit und ohne Rest, fehlende Zahlen und einfache Brüche. Lege Klassenstufe, Stellenzahl, Zahlenraum (z. B. bis 20), ohne Zehnerübergang und keine negativen Ergebnisse fest. Jede Lösung wird exakt berechnet, keine Aufgabe wiederholt sich, und eine Satznummer druckt dasselbe Blatt erneut. PDF in A4 oder Letter.

es-ES.subtitle: Fichas de matemáticas
es-ES.description: Crea fichas de matemáticas para imprimir con hoja de respuestas: sumas, restas, tablas de multiplicar, divisiones con y sin resto, números que faltan y fracciones básicas. Elige el curso, el número de cifras, el rango (por ejemplo hasta 20), sin llevadas y sin resultados negativos. Cada respuesta se calcula con exactitud, ningún ejercicio se repite y un número de serie vuelve a imprimir la misma ficha. PDF en A4 o Carta.

fr-FR.subtitle: Fiches de maths avec corrigé
fr-FR.description: Créez des fiches de mathématiques à imprimer avec corrigé : additions, soustractions, tables de multiplication, divisions avec ou sans reste, nombres manquants et fractions simples. Choisissez la classe, le nombre de chiffres, la plage (par exemple jusqu'à 20), sans retenue et sans résultat négatif. Chaque réponse est calculée exactement, aucun exercice ne se répète et un numéro de série réimprime la même fiche. PDF en A4 ou Letter.

ja-JP.subtitle: 算数プリントと解答
ja-JP.description: 解答付きの算数プリントをPDFで作成します。たし算、ひき算、九九、あまりのある・ないわり算、穴あき問題、基本の分数に対応。学年、けた数、範囲（20までなど）、くり上がり・くり下がりなし、答えがマイナスにならない設定を選べます。答えはすべて正確に計算され、同じ問題は出ず、セット番号で同じプリントを再印刷できます。用紙はA4またはレター。

pt-BR.subtitle: Atividades de matemática
pt-BR.description: Crie atividades de matemática para imprimir com gabarito: adição, subtração, tabuada, divisão com e sem resto, números que faltam e frações básicas. Escolha o ano escolar, o número de algarismos, o intervalo (por exemplo até 20), sem reagrupamento e sem resultados negativos. Cada resposta é calculada com exatidão, nenhum exercício se repete e um número de conjunto imprime a mesma atividade de novo. PDF em A4 ou Carta.
